graphs.title: Graph Theory Kingdom
graphs.subtitle: Where every journey is dots and lines

map.title: The Mapmaker's Secret
map.intro: 🗺️ **Welcome to Castle Bridges!** The royal mapmaker has a secret: to plan the knights' journeys, she doesn't draw mountains or forests. She only marks the castles… and the roads between them. Tap every castle, then every road — and see what a mathematician's map looks like!
map.tapCastles: Tap every castle on the map!
map.tapRoads: Now tap every road between them!
map.revealPrompt: All marked! Ready to see the secret?
map.qDots: The mapmaker calls castles “dots”. How many dots does this graph have?
map.qLines: And the roads are “lines”. How many lines?
map.retry: Count again — tap-count them one by one!
map.done: Dots and lines — that's ALL a graph is. And it's enough to plan every journey! 🌟

trace.title: The Knight's Patrol
trace.intro: 🐴 **The knight's morning patrol!** Every bridge must be inspected — and crossing a bridge twice wastes the whole morning. Tap a castle to start, then tap neighbor castles to ride across bridges. Cross EVERY bridge exactly once!
trace.prompt: Tap a castle to start, then ride across every bridge exactly once!
trace.roundDone: Patrol complete! 🎉 The next kingdom awaits…
trace.stuckHint1: Stuck with bridges left? Hmm — maybe begin somewhere else. Tap Start over and try a different castle!
trace.stuckHint2: 🛡️ The knights whisper: count the bridges at each castle — start where the count is ODD…
trace.done: Three kingdoms patrolled, every bridge exactly once! But there is one city no knight has ever finished… 🌟

bridges.title: The Seven Bridges of Königsberg
bridges.intro: 🌉 **The famous city of Königsberg!** A river, an island, and SEVEN bridges. For 300 years, the townspeople tried to walk across every bridge exactly once — and no one EVER managed it. Not one person. Your turn… and when you're ready, the old dragon knows why.
bridges.tryPrompt: Try the famous walk: cross all seven bridges exactly once!
bridges.countPrompt: 🐉 “Watch closely,” says the dragon. “Tap each place and COUNT its bridges.”
bridges.qOdd: 🐉 “Look at the counts. How many places have an ODD number of bridges?”
bridges.qPossible: 🐉 “A walk needs to enter and leave each middle place in pairs. With FOUR odd places… can the walk be done?”
bridges.retry: Look at the glowing counts again…
bridges.retryHint2: A place with an odd count can only start or end a walk — and a walk has only ONE start and ONE end.
bridges.provedText: In 1736, Leonhard Euler proved exactly this — no walk can cross all seven bridges once. His proof invented graph theory. Proving something is impossible is real mathematics, and today it was yours.
bridges.done: You didn't fail the puzzle — you solved the deeper one. 🐉📜

predict.title: The Dragon's Test
predict.intro: 🐉 **“Now you know my secret,”** smiles the dragon. **“More than two odd castles — no walk. Zero or two — the knight can do it!”** For each kingdom, count the bridges FIRST, then predict: possible, or impossible?
predict.prompt: Count the odd castles… then predict before the knight rides!
predict.retry: Use “Count bridges” — tap the castles and count!
predict.retryHint2: The rule: more than 2 odd castles = impossible. 0 or 2 odd castles = possible!
predict.done: You predict journeys without taking a single step — that's the power of a theorem! 🐉

banners.title: The Banner Festival
banners.intro: 🎪 **The great festival!** Every castle hoists a banner — but castles connected by a road must NEVER fly the same color, or their knights will argue all night. Pick a color, tap castles, and make the whole kingdom festive with just three colors!
banners.prompt: Pick a color, then tap castles to hoist banners. Neighbors must differ!
banners.conflict: 😾 The knights are arguing! Two connected castles fly the same banner…
banners.fourColorFact: Mapmakers proved that FOUR colors are enough for any flat map — the proof was so big it needed a computer!
banners.done: Every banner flying, not one argument. The festival is saved! 🎉

skills.map: A graph is dots and lines — I can turn a map into one
skills.trace: I can walk a graph crossing every bridge exactly once
skills.euler: I proved the Königsberg walk impossible — just like Euler in 1736
skills.odd: Odd castles tell me if a walk is possible before I even try
skills.color: I can color the kingdom's banners so no two neighbors match

graphs.finished: You discovered two great secrets: any journey can be drawn as dots and lines — and once it is, mathematics can tell you what's possible before you take a single step. Euler's dragon salutes you. 🏰🐉
